title: Abraham and God's covenant
intro: God calls Abraham to leave everything and trust His promise. Through this covenant, God reveals His plan to bless all nations. Abraham’s journey shows how faith grows through obedience and surrender.
phrasings: what is God's covenant with Abraham
promise to make Abraham a great nation

title: Jacob wrestles with God
intro: Jacob’s night of wrestling shows how God meets us in struggle and transforms us. He receives a new name, Israel, marking a turning point from fear to blessing.
phrasings: why did Jacob wrestle the angel
I feel like I'm wrestling with God

title: Joseph in Egypt
intro: Joseph’s betrayal, slavery and rise to leadership reveal how God can turn deep wounds into redemption. His forgiveness of his brothers shows a heart shaped by grace.
phrasings: how did Joseph forgive his brothers

title: Gideon and God's call
intro: Gideon begins fearful and unsure, yet God patiently strengthens him. His story shows that God often chooses unlikely people and equips them for His mission.

title: Elijah on Mount Carmel
intro: Elijah confronts false worship and shows that the Lord alone is God. His bold faith and God’s dramatic answer remind us that prayer is powerful even when we feel outnumbered.

title: The calling of Samuel
intro: God calls Samuel at a young age, showing that He speaks to those who listen with a willing heart. Samuel’s response, “Speak, Lord,” becomes a model of openness to God’s voice.
phrasings: how did Samuel hear God's voice
speak Lord your servant is listening
I want to hear God's voice

title: Elisha and Naaman
intro: Naaman’s healing shows that God works through humility and simple obedience. Elisha’s quiet confidence reveals that God’s power is not found in dramatic signs but in trusting His word.
phrasings: why did Naaman wash in the Jordan

title: Daniel in the lions' den
intro: Daniel’s courage in prayer leads him into danger, yet God protects him. His story shows that faithfulness sometimes brings trials, but God remains present and powerful.
phrasings: why was Daniel thrown to the lions

title: The three men in the fiery furnace
intro: Shadrach, Meshach and Abednego refuse to worship a false god, trusting the Lord even if He does not rescue them. God’s presence in the fire shows His closeness in trials.
phrasings: God is with me in the fire

title: Queen Esther and courage
intro: Esther risks her life to save her people, showing how God works through ordinary people placed in extraordinary moments. Her courage comes from trusting God’s providence.
phrasings: why did Esther risk her life
for such a time as this

title: David is anointed king
intro: God chooses David, the youngest and least expected, showing that He looks at the heart rather than appearances. David’s anointing marks the beginning of a life shaped by trust and courage.

title: Solomon asks for wisdom
intro: Solomon’s request for wisdom shows a heart that seeks to serve rather than to gain power. God grants him wisdom and peace, reminding us that true understanding is a gift from the Lord.

title: Elijah and the widow of Zarephath
intro: In a time of famine, God provides for Elijah through a poor widow whose trust opens the door to a miracle. Their story shows how God cares for the vulnerable and multiplies generosity.
phrasings: story of Elijah and the widow
Elijah miracle with flour and oil

title: Elisha raises the Shunammite’s son
intro: Elisha responds to a grieving mother with compassion, and God restores her child to life. The story reveals God’s tenderness and His power to bring hope where all seems lost.
phrasings: why did God raise the boy

title: The call of Isaiah
intro: Isaiah encounters God’s holiness and receives a mission to speak His word. His response, “Here I am, send me,” shows how God purifies and strengthens those He calls.

title: The fall of Jericho
intro: God brings down Jericho’s walls not through force but through obedience and trust. Israel’s victory shows that God fights for His people when they follow His lead.
phrasings: why did Israel march around Jericho

title: Gideon and the 300
intro: God reduces Gideon’s army to just 300 men to show that victory comes from Him, not human strength. Their triumph reveals God’s power working through weakness.
phrasings: why did God reduce Gideon's army

title: Ruth and Boaz
intro: Ruth’s loyalty and Boaz’s kindness reveal God’s care for the vulnerable. Their story shows how faithfulness in ordinary life becomes part of God’s larger plan.

title: Samson and his strength
intro: Samson’s strength comes from God, yet his weaknesses show the danger of pride and compromise. His final act reveals God’s ability to work even through flawed people.

title: Jonathan and David’s friendship
intro: Jonathan and David share a loyal friendship rooted in faith and sacrifice. Their bond shows the beauty of godly friendship and standing with others even at personal cost.
phrasings: why were David and Jonathan close

title: Moses and the burning bush
intro: God appears to Moses in a burning bush, calling him to lead Israel out of slavery. Moses feels unworthy and afraid, yet God promises to be with him and give him the words he needs.
phrasings: why did God speak from a bush

title: Manna in the wilderness
intro: God feeds Israel with manna, teaching them to rely on Him daily. The story shows that God provides what we need, not always what we expect, and invites us to trust His timing.

title: Balaam and the speaking donkey
intro: God uses Balaam’s donkey to open his eyes to danger and redirect him. The story shows that God can speak through unexpected means to protect us and correct our path.

title: Hannah’s prayer for a child
intro: Hannah pours out her heart before God, and He hears her prayer. Her story shows the power of honest prayer and the faithfulness of God even in long seasons of waiting.

title: David and Mephibosheth
intro: David shows kindness to Mephibosheth, the son of Jonathan, honoring a covenant of friendship. The story reveals how mercy and loyalty reflect God’s own heart.

title: Ezekiel and the valley of dry bones
intro: God shows Ezekiel a valley of dry bones and brings them to life, revealing His power to restore what seems beyond hope. The vision promises renewal for His people and reminds us that nothing is too dead for God to revive.
phrasings: can God restore what feels dead
God brings life to dry bones

title: Nehemiah rebuilds Jerusalem’s wall
intro: Nehemiah leads the rebuilding of Jerusalem’s wall despite opposition and discouragement. His perseverance and prayerful leadership show how God strengthens those who work for His purposes.

title: King Josiah and the Book of the Law
intro: Josiah discovers the Book of the Law and leads a national renewal. His response shows the power of God’s Word to convict hearts and restore faithfulness.
phrasings: Josiah finds the book of the law
why did Josiah tear his clothes

title: Jonah and the plant
intro: After Nineveh repents, Jonah becomes angry, and God uses a plant to teach him compassion. The story reveals God’s patience and His desire for us to share His mercy toward others.
phrasings: story of Jonah and the plant
why did God send the plant

title: Zechariah’s night visions
intro: God gives Zechariah a series of visions to encourage His people as they rebuild. These visions remind Israel that God is present, powerful and committed to restoring His people.
